summary: @thiennq/docs-viewer preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated sibling bundle
details: The package's declared preinstall hook (setup.mjs, itself _0xNNNN-obfuscated) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execFileSync a shipped sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs`-compiled bundle containing an obfuscator-style variable-rotation routine and a multi-thousand-entry numeric constants array that reconstructs strings at runtime. The README advertises the package as a zero-dependency Node.js built-in docs viewer and does not mention Bun, an install-time native download, or execution of a compiled bundle. Because the payload is executed by a freshly downloaded alternate runtime rather than by Node, standard Node/npm tooling cannot introspect what runs. The delivery chain — install-time fetch of a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated, undocumented sibling bundle under that runtime — matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern and diverges from the package's advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
